grammar.C: SurfaceField.sample(), FOOT_CONTACT-written compaction; no new amplitude threshold

grammar.operationOrder: Order track observations by actual timeMs then anchorIndex; begin/reset at track start, missing anchor, or exact mask-Jaccard < .60; continue at >= .60; emit one event at the first observation with current timeMs minus interval start >= 20000; a later event requires a new reset and interval.
grammar.similarityImplementation: Sorted unique row-major X cell ids; intersection cardinality divided by union cardinality. No path similarity fallback. X is nonempty by registered capture.
